name: 消防水带流量压力计算

map.输入水带入口压力、出口压力、直径与长度，由压差反算水带实际流量与流速。: Enter the hose inlet pressure, outlet pressure, diameter and length to back-calculate the hose's actual flow and velocity from the pressure difference.
map.由压差反算流量（Hazen-Williams 反解）：Q = [ΔP÷0.009: Flow from pressure drop (inverted Hazen-Williams): Q = [ΔP÷0.00980665 · C^1.852·D^4.87 ÷ (10.67·L)]^(1/1.852); velocity v = Q÷A (Q in m³/s, D in m).
map.入口压力须大于出口压力，否则无流量产生。: The inlet pressure must be greater than the outlet pressure, otherwise no flow is produced.
map.压力差即为克服沿程摩阻的水头损失，未含局部损失。: The pressure difference is the head loss to overcome friction along the hose and does not include local losses.
map.流速建议控制在 2~3 m/s 以内，过高易损伤水带。: The velocity is recommended to be kept within 2-3 m/s; too high a value easily damages the hose.
map.结果用于现场流量估算，实际以流量计或压力表校核为准。: The result is for on-site flow estimation; in practice the flow meter or pressure gauge reading prevails.
map.给排水与消防管网设计中按压差、管径估算流量、流速与水头损失。: In water-supply and fire-pipe network design, estimate the flow, velocity and head loss from the pressure difference and pipe diameter.
map.校核管段流速是否超过经济/安全上限，判断是否需要放大管径。: Verify whether the pipe-section velocity exceeds the economic/safety upper limit and judge whether the diameter needs enlarging.
map.泵房或喷淋系统调试时反算管径与流量是否匹配设计工况。: During pump-room or sprinkler system commissioning, back-calculate whether the diameter and flow match the design condition.
map.压差 0.2 MPa 下的管段校核: Pipe-section verification at a 0.2 MPa pressure difference
map.按默认参数（压差 0.2000 MPa、管径对应流速约 8.98 m/s）：流量: With the default parameters (pressure difference 0.2000 MPa, velocity about 8.98 m/s for the diameter): flow 29.78 L/s (107.2 m³/h), velocity 8.98 m/s, friction head loss about 20.39 m. The tool rates it 'velocity too high' — the economic velocity of a water-supply pipe is usually 1-3 m/s, and even a fire main should not exceed 5 m/s for long; it is recommended to enlarge the diameter or shorten the pipe section to reduce the velocity and head loss.
map.流速多高算过高？: What velocity counts as too high?
map.生活给水管经济流速约 1~3 m/s，消防管道可短时较高但不宜长期超过 5 m/: The economic velocity of a domestic water-supply pipe is about 1-3 m/s, and a fire pipe may be higher briefly but should not exceed 5 m/s for long; too high a velocity significantly increases head loss, causes water hammer and noise, and accelerates pipe-wall wear.
map.在同流量下放大管径可近似按面积平方降低流速（管径翻倍流速降到约 1/4），是控制: At the same flow, enlarging the diameter lowers the velocity roughly by the square of the area (doubling the diameter cuts the velocity to about 1/4), the most direct way to control velocity and head loss.
map.通过水带入口与出口压力差，利用哈森-威廉公式反算水带实际流量与流速，用于现场供水: Using the pressure difference between the hose inlet and outlet and the Hazen-Williams formula to back-calculate the hose's actual flow and velocity, for on-site supply-status assessment and hydraulic verification.
map.由压差反算流量与流速: Back-calculates the flow and velocity from the pressure difference
map.自动评估流速是否合理: Automatically assesses whether the velocity is reasonable
map.支持多种口径与水带类型: Supports multiple diameters and hose types
